title: RoseGold Copper tools
description: Another rose copper gold tools mod. You know the drill.
body:
Adds a recipe for rosegold creation by using the smithing table.
Use the smithing table with this ratio - 1 copper + 1 gold + 1 copper = rosegold

Adds rosegold tools for rosegold usage. The tools are faster and better than iron but are still weaker than iron.
(You wont be able to mine diamonds with rosegold tools)

This mod was made cause no other rosegold mods were updated to 1.21.8 Neo
